run_web_search_tool: run the web_search_tool to search the web with a query and return JSON results with titles, URLs, and snippets
run_web_fetch_tool: run the web_fetch_tool to fetch the contents of a web page at a given URL and return the title and text
build_exa_client: build an Exa API client using the _get_exa_client helper with an optional API key from app config
test_web_search_tool: test the web_search_tool with various query strings and configurable max_results, search_type, and contents_max_characters
refactor_web_fetch_tool: refactor the web_fetch_tool to handle URL validation and ensure proper HTTPS schema requirement enforcement
